name: example_invoice_check
description: Check an invoice. The invoice input has one line per item, of the form 'item | quantity | unit price in euros'. Read the note and say whether the customer is 'happy', 'unhappy' or 'neutral'. Return the text '<n> lines, total <amount> EUR, <mood>', where n is the number of lines and amount is the sum of quantity times unit price, written with exactly two decimals.
